title: MetLife Inc - proposed acquisition of Citicorp Life Insurance Limited and Citicorp General Insurance Limited

body_sections.Summary: Metlife Inc - proposed acquisition of Citicorp Life Insurance Limited and Citicorp General Insurance Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The supply of direct life insurance and life reinsurance in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: There is no overlap between Metlife (which has an interest in a life reinsurer in Australia) and Citicorp (which is primarily involved in direct life insurance, as it ceased writing general insurance in 2000).
